title: Shower Curtain Rod Brackets For 1-Inch Rod, Solid Brass Pair | Antique Copper | Shower Curtain Rod Brackets | Allied Brass
description:
Finish a bathroom shower curtain rod installation with matching wall-mounted brackets that keep your rod supported and your space coordinated in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. These shower curtain rod brackets (also called shower rod brackets or shower rod holders) are sold as a pair and are made for use with any 1-inch diameter shower rod.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Fits standard sizing: designed for any 1-inch diameter shower rod
- Coordinate design: part of the shower curtain rod brackets collection for transitional bathroom hardware that pairs with versatile bath accessories
multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 3 in. x 2.25 in. x 3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 in. x 6 in. x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs.
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging bracket style for a shower rod
- Quantity: sold as a pair
- Shower rod: must be purchased separately
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: assembled in the USA
